title: Wonder Woman
description: After leaving her island for the first time, Wonder Woman discovers her full powers and true destiny while fighting alongside men in a war to end all wars.

title: Aquaman
description: Aquaman must retrieve the legendary Trident of Atlan to save the underwater city of Atlantis -- and the surface world -- from his power-hungry brother.

title: NHL on TNT Face Off
description: Anson Carter, Paul Bissonnette, Henrik Lundqvist and Liam McHugh present pregame coverage.

title: NHL Hockey
description:
Chicago Blackhawks at Florida Panthers
The Florida Panthers host the Chicago Blackhawks in an NHL regular-season game at Amerant Bank Arena. At 8-5-2, Florida has won four of the last five meetings between the sides, while Chicago arrives at 4-10-1 having lost four of its last five games.

title: NHL Hockey
description:
San Jose Sharks at Los Angeles Kings
The Los Angeles Kings host the San Jose Sharks in an NHL regular-season game at crypto.com Arena. Los Angeles sit 4-7-2 and have alternated wins and losses over their last five, San Jose enters 7-8-1 and took their previous meeting 5-4 on Oct. 3.

title: NHL Post-Game on TNT
description: Liam McHugh, Anson Carter and Paul Bissonnette recap the night in the NHL.

title: Foul Play With Anthony Davis
description:
S01 E06 — Bet the Farm
Anthony Davis and Dude Perfect's Cody Jones push Dereck Lively into a game-show disaster, while USC basketball player JuJu Watkins and coach Lindsey Gottlieb prank their team with a fake meeting that leaves them stranded on a haunted abandoned floor.

title: Cold Case
description:
S02 E02 — Factory Girls
A reunion of World War II factory workers stirs up memories of a mysterious death, and a friend of the deceased begs Lilly to investigate the killing.

title: Cold Case
description:
S02 E03 — Daniela
Lilly receives a home movie in which a runaway teen is apparently shot and killed, prompting her to take another look at the 1979 case.

title: Cold Case
description:
S02 E04 — The House
Human bones are found at the site of a now shuttered prison, the scene of melee and murder 36 years before.

title: Cold Case
description:
S02 E05 — Who's Your Daddy?
A gold bracelet turns up, prompting Lilly to reopen the case of two Cambodian immigrants believed to have been murdered during a robbery.

title: Cold Case
description:
S02 E06 — Sleepover
The strangulation of a young woman mirrors the unsolved case of a 12-year-old girl in 1989, murdered at the home of a troubled teenager (Carly Schroeder).

title: Cold Case
description:
S02 E07 — It's Raining Men
A long-term AIDS survivor asks Rush and Valens to reopen the case involving his murdered partner, an AIDS activist and scorned member of a prominent family.

title: Cold Case
description:
S02 E08 — Red Glare
The communist witch hunts of the 1950s come back to haunt their survivors when Lilly and the team reopen an unsolved murder case.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E08 — Codename: Ferdinand
A car crash results in the death of a photographer; Maggie sympathizes with his widow when she notices similarities with her own husband's death.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E09 — Salvation
After an altercation with a student, teacher Patrick Miller goes missing, leading the team to investigate everyone who might have had a grudge against him; a key witness in the case steps up to help.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E10 — Ties That Bind
A former kidnapping victim is linked to a series of murders that includes the daughter of an NYPD detective; Kristen begins to doubt her ability as an agent after a training exercise leaves her shaken.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E11 — Fallout
After a businessman with a history of harassment claims against him is killed, the team suspects the killer may be one of his many accusers.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E12 — Hard Decisions
A bank holdup leads the team to a safe deposit box, the contents of which have the potential to destroy national security; Kristen is eager to get back into field work while other team members still have their concerns.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E13 — Payback
The son of a retired FBI agent is kidnapped, and the team must investigate if it's an act of revenge; Isobel must make a hard call when information from the past comes to light.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E14 — Studio Gangster
When an attorney is found dead near the body of a private escort, the team must piece together what connected the two seemingly random victims; Jubal's connection with one of the victims makes finding the killer much more personal.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E15 — Legacy
After a truck filled with armor-piercing rifles is hijacked, the team works to discover who stole it, and what they have planned for the stolen weapons; a friend from OA's past returns to help with the case, but OA isn't sure he can trust him.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E16 — Safe Room
After the police ignore a desperate father's plea for help, he abducts a billionaire's daughter and holds her hostage in a safe room until his own missing child is returned to him; Jubal puts his hostage negotiation skills to the test.

title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

title: Kong: Skull Island
description: Scientists, soldiers and adventurers encounter the mighty Kong and other monstrous creatures after traveling to an uncharted island in the Pacific Ocean.

title: Meg 2: The Trench
description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

title: Godzilla vs. Kong
description: Fearsome monsters Godzilla and Kong square off in an epic battle for the ages. The initial confrontation between the two titans -- instigated by unseen forces -- is only the beginning of the mystery that lies deep within the core of the planet.

title: FBI
description:
S06 E07 — Behind the Veil
When a bombing at a local restaurant leaves several injured or dead, including a congresswoman and someone close to Isobel, the team races to apprehend the suspect before another explosive goes off.

title: FBI
description:
S06 E08 — Phantom
After an employee of the U.S. Army is shot in an industrial park, the team works to track down the killer who reveals a larger plot at play; Tiffany continues to struggle with the guilt surrounding Hobbs' death.

title: FBI
description:
S06 E09 — Best Laid Plans
When a retired FBI agent is tortured and killed while working a security job, Scola and Nina go undercover as a married couple deep in the diamond game as the team tries to find out who is responsible.

title: FBI
description:
S06 E10 — Family Affair
After an FDIC security guard is killed while tending to a pregnant woman in distress, the team works to locate the woman and the killer who took her hostage; OA and Isobel worry about Maggie as she navigates taking care of Ella.

title: FBI
description:
S06 E11 — No One Left Behind
The team is thrown into a highly political case after four members of the Taliban are shot and one is kidnapped in New York with no record of their entrance into the country; OA struggles to open up to Gemma about his past in Afghanistan.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E17 — Broken Promises
When the team is called to the scene of a murder, it quickly suspects political motivation; Maggie contemplates a decision that could affect her entire career.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E18 — American Dreams
Jess LaCroix and his team come to help OA find a fugitive LaCroix arrested years ago after a bus with 26 students goes missing, and he's the main suspect.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E19 — Emotional Rescue
The team investigates a drug deal gone bad after the body of a college student is found; Detective Hailey Upton temporarily joins the team and finds her investigative methods clash with the Bureau's more buttoned-up environment.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E01 — Never Trust a Stranger
The team welcomes a new member, Special Agent Tiffany Wallace, as they search for killers who orchestrated a mass shooting at a media company; OA's personal connection with the case threatens to cloud his judgment.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E02 — Unreasonable Doubt
The team races to stop an active serial killer after three women are found weighted down at the bottom of a lake; Jubal looks into an old closed case after there are multiple similarities to the recent victims.

description: Scientists, soldiers and adventurers encounter the mighty Kong and other monstrous creatures after traveling to an uncharted island in the Pacific Ocean.

title: Godzilla vs. Kong
description: Fearsome monsters Godzilla and Kong square off in an epic battle for the ages. The initial confrontation between the two titans -- instigated by unseen forces -- is only the beginning of the mystery that lies deep within the core of the planet.

title: CBB Hall of Fame Series Pregame
description: Pregame analysis of season-opening college basketball matchups from Las Vegas.

title: College Basketball
description:
UConn vs. Michigan
From TD Garden in Boston.

title: CBB Hall of Fame Series Postgame
description: Men's and women's college basketball postgame coverage. From Las Vegas.

title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
description: When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives and the fate of the world.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E03 — Liar's Poker
When the leader of a drug cartel and one of the world's most wanted men is apprehended by the team, the entire FBI headquarters is put at risk when his henchmen unveil a plot to free him; Isobel must make a difficult decision.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E04 — Crazy Love
A shooting at a quinceañera leaves two dead, but the team believes they may not have been the intended targets; Maggie is conflicted as the team decides the best plan of action for using a witness to take down their suspect.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E05 — Clean Slate
The team searches for a young girl who was kidnapped from a cabin during a family vacation; Maggie questions her relationship with Nestor when she learns he hasn't been completely honest with her.

title: FBI
description:
S06 E12 — Consequences
When a truck driver is murdered and the drug he was transporting goes missing, the team hunts for those behind the remaining batch that is already wreaking havoc on the streets of New York.

title: FBI
description:
S06 E13 — Ring of Fire
The Somalian terrorist group behind the death of Agent Hobbs resurfaces, sending the team on a chase to take them down for good.

title: FBI
description:
S07 E01 — Abandoned
The assassination of a seemingly ordinary Brooklyn plumber launches the team into a globe-spanning investigation that ruffles feathers with the CIA; Tiffany struggles with fieldwork in the aftermath of the Hakim case.

title: FBI
description:
S07 E02 — Trusted
The team is on the case when a suburban couple is murdered; all forensic evidence points to the home's previous owner, who is currently serving 10 years in federal prison; OA reunites with an old military colleague; Scola welcomes a new partner.

title: FBI
description:
S07 E03 — Détente
After a series of targeted bombings in Queens, the team fears a citywide gang war is imminent, until a tip from OA's old Army buddy, Clay, directs their attention to an unexpected and powerful foe; Scola continues to struggle to find a new partner.

title: Black Adam
description: Bestowed with the almighty powers of the gods, Black Adam's unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone.

title: Big 12 Football Pregame
description: Champ Bailey, Takeo Spikes, Victor Cruz and Adam Lefkoe preview the Big 12 football game of the week.

title: College Football
description:
Oklahoma State at Kansas State
From Bill Snyder Family Football Stadium in Manhattan, Kan.

title: Big 12 Football Postgame
description: Champ Bailey, Takeo Spikes, Victor Cruz and Adam Lefkoe wrap up the night in the Big 12.

title: Angels in the Outfield
description: The manager (Danny Glover) of the lowly California Angels puts his faith in a boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) who can see an angel.

title: Central Intelligence
description: A lethal CIA agent (Dwayne Johnson) and his former classmate (Kevin Hart) encounter shootouts, espionage and double-crosses while trying to save the U.S. spy satellite system.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E07 — Ready or Not
Maggie returns from medical leave and helps the team investigate two homicides: a law student and a young man with possible gang ties; an inadvertent revelation from Maggie causes OA to worry that she is rushing back into the job too quickly.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E08 — Into the Fire
When a deadly truck heist arms the killers with enough ammonium nitrate to construct a massive bomb, the team discovers a link to a terrorist group Maggie is working to infiltrate.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E09 — Fortunate Son
A teen shows up at FBI headquarters with a large bag of fentanyl, seeking the team's protection from the men who shot his father; Nina goes to Scola with a proposal he is hesitant to accept.

title: All Elite Wrestling: Collision
description:
S04 E48
The all new matches, more stories and more action, featuring the world-class All Elite Wrestling roster.

title: The Accountant
description: A Treasury agent (J.K. Simmons) closes in on a brilliant freelance accountant (Ben Affleck) who works for dangerous criminal organizations.
